decisions.reason: The construction site dumper appears to be a less differentiated and more weakly positioned side product, so management would likely exit it if 2019-2021 demand did not clearly justify continued support.
The inclined furniture lift fits the firm's lifting niche well and benefits from customization, service and parts support, making it likely to remain in the portfolio.
The inclined building material lift is closely aligned with the firm's core strengths in specialized lifting equipment and should be retained as a credible niche product line.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is more specialized and capital-intensive than the basic lift lines, but it still complements the firm's lifting portfolio enough to keep for now.
